effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, give 1 of your opponent's Digimon "[On Deletion] Trash 1 card in your hand." until the end of their turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand.
